mission: Improve and observe technically valid, people-first discoverability across classical search and separately defined AI-answer environments.

conditions: Enable a technical preflight when owned-web discoverability is part of the project motion.
Run later when search or AI-discovery evidence can change a decision.

requirements: Defines target surface, locale, and decision question.
Website and discovery surfaces are revision-pinned.
Pins queries, engines, prompts, locale, time, and denominator.

outputs.purpose: Combines technical findings, prioritized fixes, observation design, and bounded interpretation.

quality_rules: Keep ranking, mentions, citations, traffic, and product value separate.
Do not infer missing observations as zero.
Do not recommend hidden instructions, keyword stuffing, or link spam.
stop_conditions: Required surface or observation set is undefined.
The task asks for publication or index-manipulation action.
